Frequently asked questions

What does sVn Business do?
Record sales, orders, customers, products and expenses in one app, and see revenue, profit and unpaid balances. Includes invoices, receipts, sVn Share and sVn Studio.
Who can use it?
Any business owner, from a small shop to a growing brand. Use it on your phone or in a browser.
What is the difference between Free and Pro?
Free covers the essentials for one business. Pro adds sales analytics, the Money Leak Detector, reports and CSV exports, up to 6 businesses, your logo on invoices and unlimited Studio exports.
How much is Pro?
₦1,000 a month at the launch price through 2026, then ₦2,500 from January 2027. Paystack handles payment, and each payment adds 30 days. An annual plan is coming soon.
How do I get started?
Create a free account with your name, business, phone and email, or use Google. New accounts get a 7-day Pro trial.
Is my data safe?
Your data is stored securely with Google Firebase and is only available to your account. We never sell it, and Paystack handles card details. Export your data anytime from Profile.
How do I contact support?
Use the Email support button here, or open Settings, then Support, in the app.

Need help?

Send us an email. We will help.
